text.from: Each team's likely starting QB, then the RBs, WRs and TEs getting the most work over its last 4 games (carries + targets), with per-game averages over the games you pick (H2H = his games against this opponent, this season and last). Under each team: who has missed games, and anyone removed because he's out for the season. Grade = this week's matchup: A+ = the defense allows the most to his position (easiest), F = the least (toughest). Tap a player for his full prop card.

text.from: Per-game numbers with each unit's rank among all 32 teams for the same stretch of games. Ranks on this page: 1 = the best offense, or the defense that allows the least (toughest matchup); 32 = the weakest offense, or the defense that allows the most (easiest). The longer bar is the stronger unit: green when the offense has the edge, red when the defense does.
